portInfo.description: St. Thomas splits large-ship calls between the VIPA Austin “Babe” Monsanto Marine Terminal in Crown Bay (Subbase) and the privately operated WICO Dock at Havensight/Long Bay. VIPA documents Crown Bay as one of two island cruise ports, with a main dock (940 ft south / 37 ft draft Oasis-capable; 940 ft north / 28 ft draft), a 435 ft adjoining dock (27 ft draft), and a small excursion dock. WICO describes century-plus ownership of the Havensight Dock and publishes schedules that label WICO versus Crown Bay berths separately. VIPA’s Charlotte Amalie Waterfront bulkhead (3,200 ft; 4–14 ft draft) handles tenders and mini-cruise ships beside downtown shopping — not Oasis-class alongside traffic. Always read the day’s pier assignment before planning a “short walk to Main Street.”

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Crown Bay Center is on-terminal; downtown minutes unverified. Havensight shops are adjacent to WICO. Waterfront shopping is beside the bulkhead. Use 75–90 min buffers even for “nearby” malls on multi-ship days.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.
